origin: Real SSH login of the remote helper, recorded by test/run.sh --capture (SSHSpaceTests/testSSHTmuxHandoffLoginStaysHiddenAcrossReconnect, 2026-10-14); its expanded bytes unchanged, recorded as bzip2 and recompressed on 2026-10-17 as zstd, one level-1 frame per bzip2 member, as a live capture is written now. Replaces the Linux login capture, which was never committed. Scrubbed on 2026-10-19 frame by frame (each recompressed at level 1 with its checksum, the frames kept): this Mac's host name, kernel and boot ids and temporary folder name replaced by values of the same length, as the replay corpus has them.
usage: Collection and transfer regressions use the original bytes; the second zstd frame is what a running helper appends after its startup checkpoint. Native replay also needs the original launch context; no context has been synthesized.
